### Just Be You - Today's Insight - February 2, 2021
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-february-2-2021.html
Passage: Amos 7:14-15
Points:
- Contemporary culture and religious communities often push individuals to conform to standard molds and institutional expectations.
- Amos was an ordinary shepherd and fig-picker who did not fit the traditional image of an official prophet.
- When religious leaders tried to silence him, Amos stood firm on God's call rather than professional credentials.
- Christians do not need to change their God-given uniqueness merely to blend in with the majority.
- The church needs authentic believers who stay true to their calling and remain themselves.
